ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: The mandatory screening protocol requires continuous risk-based assessment of all identified UBOs, directors, shareholders, beneficial owners, and authorized signatories against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated Lists, OFAC's Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List and sectoral sanctions lists, Her Majesty's Treasury consolidated list of financial sanctions targets, European Union consolidated financial sanctions list, and the domestic sanctions and designated persons lists announced by the Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China and the Hong Kong Monetary Authority pursuant to the United Nations Sanctions Ordinance (Cap. 537). Screening must include positive and negative matching, fuzzy matching, phonetic matching for Chinese names transliterated into English, and cross-referencing of aliases, former names, and passport numbers. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for any person identified as a Politically Exposed Person under FATF Recommendation 12, including foreign PEPs, domestic PEPs, family members, and close associates. Any positive sanctions hit is an automatic disqualification unless an exemption or official delisting is evidenced in writing and reviewed by a senior compliance officer. The entire screening process must be documented in a written risk assessment, maintained for at least five years, and made available to the Hong Kong Companies Registry, the Companies and Securities Division, and PBOC/SAMR upon request under Order No. 3.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_note: China (WFOE) UBO disclosure is strictly Government_Only_Access under PBOC/SAMR Order No. 3, effective November 1, 2024, and is not publicly searchable.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Hong Kong Companies Registry e-Search and ICRIS (Integrated Companies Registry Information System) for name reservation; SAMR National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System and online enterprise registration platform for the Chinese WFOE name clearance.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The Hong Kong name may be in English, Chinese, or both; if a Chinese name is used, it must be in traditional Chinese characters and a romanized transliteration in the English name field is required for reference. The mainland WFOE must have a Chinese name consistent with the SAMR enterprise name registration rules, usually structured as: administrative division + distinctive name + industry description + legal form. The English name of the WFOE must match the Hong Kong registered English name or the approved transliteration, and the pinyin transliteration of the Chinese name must be provided in the capitalization table and registration filings. Any mismatch between the Chinese character name, pinyin, and English name may invalidate the registration or impede bank account opening and customs licensing for medical PPE exports.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Export-controlled tokens requiring ministerial approval under the Medical Device Regulation
Sterile/infection-control terms that may imply regulatory approval without license
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: For a name rejection from the Hong Kong Companies Registry, the applicant must, within 14 days of rejection, file a notice of appeal in writing with the Registry, stating the legal basis for the proposed name, the availability search reference, and evidence that the name is not identical or misleadingly similar to an existing name. The Registry may extend the reservation upon payment of the prescribed extension fee and submission of a fresh search certificate. If the appeal is unsuccessful, the applicant may apply to the Companies Tribunal or seek judicial review in the Court of First Instance. For a WFOE name rejected by SAMR, the applicant must submit a written administrative reconsideration petition to the immediately higher SAMR authority within 60 days of the rejection, attaching the original application form, rejection notice, and legal support. If reconsideration is refused, administrative litigation before the People's Court is available within six months. During the appeal procedure, the applicant may also file a new name reservation with alternative name structures to avoid delay in the incorporation timeline.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: For the Hong Kong vehicle, a virtual office is generally permissible for holding companies and nominee purposes, but must include a physical registered address in Hong Kong at which the Companies Registry, Inland Revenue Department, and law enforcement can serve process. A commercial mailbox service without a registered office address is unlawful under Cap. 622. For the mainland WFOE, virtual office or commercial mailbox arrangements are rejected by local SAMR, tax authorities, and banks. The ISIC 3250/339113 medical PPE manufacturing scope requires a physical production site, warehouse, quality-control laboratory, and registered operational address. The WFOE's business license will be revoked if the registered office is a virtual mailbox because the medical glove production license, export customs registration, and VAT invoice control require physical inspection by the market supervision bureau and tax authorities. A virtual office may only be used as a secondary correspondence address after the physical factory is fully registered and licensed.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Checklist for physical inspections: (1) verify the production line exists, including dipping tanks, drying tunnels, chlorination and washing systems, and packaging lines; (2) confirm environmental certification, cleanroom status, and wastewater permits; (3) inspect the registered office at the address listed on the WFOE business license; (4) ensure the signboard and Sino-foreign ownership plaque match the registered name; (5) review labor records and social insurance filings at the workplace; (6) test the inline quality control and sampling records; and (7) examine the medical device production license and its production address verses registered address. Quantified risk: approximately 60% to 70% likelihood of an unannounced market regulation or tax bureau inspection within the first year of operation for a manufacturing WFOE in this sector, and approximately 30% for the Hong Kong office if operating from a TCSP address, but that risk rises to 60% or above if the Hong Kong entity claims economic substance solely from outsourced administrative services but has no employee, bank account, or management presence in Hong Kong.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.statutory_mandate_note: Both the Hong Kong company and the mainland WFOE must at all times have a registered office and a designated registered agent or legal representative. The WFOE must maintain permanent business premises in mainland China for the licensed medical PPE activity.

stage_1.authentication_path_summary_note: Hague Apostille and Consular Legalization are strictly parallel and mutually exclusive. They must never be chained sequentially. Each document is examined independently to determine whether its issuing jurisdiction is a member of the Apostille Convention. If yes, only the Apostille path applies. If no, the Consular Legalization path before the relevant embassy/consulate is required, and no apostille may be superadded.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Company Law of the People's Republic of China (adopted 1993, comprehensively revised 2018 and effective 2023 revision), Articles 7, 23, 26, 37, 44-49, 50-53, 66 and 76; Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019), Articles 6, 12 and 14; Interim Regulations on the Market Registration of Companies and the Foreign Investment Information Reporting Measures; where the investing shareholder is a Hong Kong S.A.R. company, Companies Ordinance (Cap. 622) of Hong Kong, sections 67, 75, 112 and 122, together with the Hong Kong Business Registration Ordinance (Cap. 310), apply to the shareholder authorization and notarial certificate.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) and the relevant municipal or provincial Administration for Market Regulation in the place of the WFOE registered office; for the Hong Kong parent, the Companies Registry of Hong Kong S.A.R.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Company Establishment Registration Application Form for a Wholly Foreign-Owned Enterprise (Foreign-Invested Limited Liability Company) filed through the SAMR National Enterprise Registration Online Service, accompanied by the Articles of Association, appointment instruments, lease documents, and the Foreign Investment Information Report.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum registered capital is prescribed for a general manufacturing WFOE under PRC Company Law. The Articles of Association must state the registered capital in RMB or an acceptable foreign currency, the contribution period, and the method of contribution (cash, equipment, or receivables). No government-blocked escrow account is required as a matter of national company law. However, for a sterile nitrile examination glove manufacturing project, the registered capital amount should be sufficient to cover industrial site acquisition or lease, dipping and curing lines, cleanroom and sterilization equipment, environmental infrastructure, and working capital, and paid-in funds must be remitted through a domestic foreign-currency capital account opened at a SAFE-designated bank. The foreign investor must report paid-in capital contributions and beneficial ownership through the Ministry of Commerce Foreign Investment Information System within the statutory deadline.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED by the Board of Directors of CN WFOE Ltd (the Company) by written resolution in lieu of a meeting, adopted on this ____ day of ____________, 20____, pursuant to the Company Law of the People's Republic of China, the Articles of Association of the Company, and the shareholder resolution of the sole shareholder, Hong Kong Parent Company Limited, as follows: 1. Registered Capital Subscription. The Board acknowledges and records that the sole shareholder has subscribed to the entire registered capital of the Company in the amount of [US$______ or RMB______], such registered capital to be contributed in cash or in kind in accordance with the capital contribution schedule attached to the Articles of Association. The Board resolves that the legal representative and general manager are hereby authorized to open a foreign-currency capital account, receive the shareholder remittance, issue a capital contribution certificate, and effect all market regulation, tax, foreign exchange, and business filing related to the subscription and contribution. 2. Banking Authorization. The Board designates [name of bank] as the principal banker of the Company and approves the opening of a RMB basic settlement account, foreign-currency capital account, and any necessary ancillary accounts. The Board authorizes the legal representative, the general manager, and the finance officer, subject to a joint signature threshold of not less than [amount], to execute account opening documents, banking mandates, loan agreements, and SWIFT/TT payment instructions for the lawful corporate purposes of the Company. 3. Registered Office Adoption. The Board adopts the legal domicile at [address, city, province, China] and confirms that the premises have lawful right of use for medical glove dipping, assembly, warehousing, and sterilization. The general manager is authorized to execute the lease, to file the address with the market regulation authority, and to procure all building, environmental, fire safety, and municipal approvals related to the premises. 4. Appointment of Statutory Officers. The Board appoints [Name] as the legal representative, [Name] as the general manager, and [Name] as the supervisor of the Company. The legal representative and general manager are jointly and severally authorized to sign, submit, receive, and amend any registration, licensing, tax, environmental, medical products, customs, and foreign exchange instruments required to establish and operate the Company. The supervisor is appointed with the full statutory powers of inspection and supervision under PRC company law. 5. Continuing Resolution. This resolution shall be full and conclusive authority for the officers, lawyers, accountants, and agents of the Company to take any action contemplated in this resolution and to correct any technical defect in any filing. This resolution shall remain in force until revoked or amended by a subsequent resolution of the Board of Directors.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pre-Registration Name Reservation and Hong Kong Shareholder Notarization
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: SAMR National Enterprise Credit Information and Registration Online Portal (zwfw.samr.gov.cn) and the local Administration for Market Regulation name-review window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Secure a proposed Chinese company name in the format City plus Trade Name plus Industry plus Company Limited, or a WFOE-compatible name for the foreign-invested entity. File the name reservation application online. Concurrently obtain a certified copy of the Hong Kong shareholder certificate of incorporation, business registration certificate, certificate of good standing, and the shareholder board resolution approving the WFOE. Have these documents notarized by a Hong Kong notary public and legalized or apostilled according to mainland China requirements. Upload the documents to the SAMR name reservation module, verify the industrial classification ISIC 3250 and NAICS 339113, and await issuance of the name pre-approval notice. The pre-approved name is generally reserved for up to six months and must be used in the formal incorporation application before expiry.
required_dossiers: Hong Kong shareholder Certificate of Incorporation and Business Registration
Notarization and legalization or apostille of Hong Kong corporate documents
Shareholder board resolution authorizing the WFOE and appointing the legal representative
Power of Attorney to the local formation agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name reservation is rejected because of duplication or prohibited wording, select two alternative names and resubmit on the same online queue. If the notarial certificate is challenged for lack of legalization, obtain a supplementary certificate from the China-appointed legal service office or a notary in Hong Kong. If the pre-approval expires due to administrative delay, immediately re-file the name application while preserving the original notarized shareholder documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of WFOE Establishment Registration with Market Regulation Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Municipal or Provincial Administration for Market Regulation where the registered office is located, through the SAMR Company Establishment Registration module
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Compile the complete establishment dossier. The sole shareholder must execute the Articles of Association in compliance with PRC Company Law and the Foreign Investment Law, and the proposed legal representative, directors or executive director, supervisor, and general manager must execute appointment instruments. The registered office must be supported by a lease agreement or property ownership certificate showing the legal right to use the premises for manufacturing, warehousing, and medical device production. Submit the Foreign Investment Information Report identifying the Hong Kong shareholder, the ultimate beneficial owner, the ISIC 3250 business scope, and the intended manufacture of sterile nitrile examination gloves. The registration authority will examine the name reservation, domicile, registered capital, legal representative capacity, business scope, and governance provisions. Upon approval, SAMR issues the unified social credit code business license and records the company in the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System. If a site inspection is required, the applicant must provide access to the registered address.
required_dossiers: Articles of Association signed by the sole shareholder
Appointment instruments for legal representative, directors, supervisor, and general manager
Lease agreement or property ownership certificate
Identity documents of legal representative and senior officers
Statement of lawful industrial use of the registered address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SAMR issues a correction notice, cure the defect within fifteen days and resubmit. If the application is suspended because the business scope exceeds the industrial permit, narrow the business scope to the manufacture of medical examination gloves and related medical protective equipment. If the site inspection reveals unlawful building use, secure a compliant industrial-grade property, amend the lease, and re-file. If the registration is rejected, file an administrative reconsideration application with the local government within sixty days or bring an administrative lawsuit within six months.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Company Seal Approval, Bank Account Opening, Tax Registration, and Foreign Exchange Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau seal engraving approval; commercial bank authorized for foreign currency; State Taxation Administration local office; State Administration of Foreign Exchange through the reporting bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After obtaining the business license, order the physical company chop set, comprising the statutory seal, legal representative seal, finance seal, contract seal, and invoice seal, from a Public Security Bureau licensed engraving shop, and file the seal impression records with the PSB. Open a RMB basic settlement account at a domestic bank using the business license and seal set. Open a foreign-currency capital account for receipt of the shareholder's paid-in capital. Complete tax registration within thirty days of the business license date, register for general VAT taxpayer status if projected annual sales reach the statutory threshold, and obtain the invoice type appropriate for medical device sales. Register the foreign investment information with SAFE through the bank capital project system, and upon receipt of the remittance, issue a capital contribution certificate to the Hong Kong shareholder and update the capital contribution ledger. All SWIFT and TT remittances must include the correct remittance purpose code for foreign investor paid-in capital.
required_dossiers: Legal representative identity document and authorization
Seal registration form issued by PSB
Bank account opening application and board authorization
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects account opening because of beneficial ownership or source-of-funds queries, provide the organizational chart, audited parent financial statements, subscription agreement, and notarized shareholder authorization. If SAFE rejects the capital account filing, correct the remittance purpose code to foreign investor paid-in capital and resubmit through the reporting bank. If tax registration is suspended because the social security link is missing, complete social insurance registration at the local social security bureau and then return to the tax application queue.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Social Insurance, Housing Fund, Statistics, and Occupational Health Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Human Resources and Social Security Bureau; Housing Provident Fund Management Centre; Statistics Bureau; Municipal Health Commission for occupational health notification
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register the WFOE as an employer within thirty days of business license issuance. Submit the employee roster, standard labor contracts, wage schedule, and company work rules to the human resources and social security bureau. Open housing fund accounts for the legal entity and employees. Register the company in the national basic statistical unit database. Because the plant will conduct nitrile compounding, dipping, curing, leaching, stripping, chlorination, and ethylene oxide or gamma sterilization, the company must notify the health commission and commission a pre-operational occupational hazard evaluation under the Law on Prevention and Control of Occupational Diseases. The employer identification codes from this step are also necessary before applying for medical device production licensing.
required_dossiers: Workplace safety and health management system
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If social insurance registration fails because of a mismatch between the registered office and the social security address, first correct the address through SAMR and then resubmit. If the housing fund application is rejected because the building ownership certificate is incomplete, obtain the landlord certificate or replace the registered office. If the pre-operational occupational hazard evaluation identifies exposure above national limits, redesign the ventilation and containment systems and resubmit the evaluation before production begins.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Environmental Impact Assessment, Civil Defense Fire Safety Approval, and NMPA Medical Device Licensing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Municipal Ecological Environment Bureau; Civil Defense Fire and Rescue Division; Provincial Medical Products Administration delegated by the National Medical Products Administration (NMPA); Municipal Housing and Urban-Rural Construction Department
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Before installing dipping lines, submit the project for environmental impact assessment classification. For a chemical dipping and sterilization facility, prepare a full Environmental Impact Report with public participation, submit it to the municipal ecological environment bureau, and obtain the formal EIA approval. After construction but before commercial production, apply for a medical device registration certificate for the sterile nitrile examination gloves by submitting type testing, sterilization validation, product standards, clinical evaluation or exemption grounds, and ISO 13485 quality system documentation under YY/T 0287. Apply for the Medical Device Production License from the provincial medical products administration after a factory inspection. Obtain civil defense fire safety design review and completion acceptance certificates, structural load clearance for dipping tanks and curing ovens, and registration of any special equipment such as boilers, compressors, and sterilization vessels. Do not commence production until the EIA acceptance filing, fire safety acceptance certificate, and NMPA medical device production license are all issued.
required_dossiers: Project filing or investment approval certificate
Civil Defense fire safety design review certificate
Medical Device Registration Certificate application with type test report
NMPA Medical Device Production License application form
Plant floor plan and process flow diagram
Hazardous chemical storage inventory and safety assessment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the EIA approval is rejected, revise the pollution prevention measures and re-submit within the appeal period or apply for administrative reconsideration within sixty days. If NMPA issues a deficiency list during technical review, respond in writing within sixty working days with supplementary testing or validation data. If the fire safety acceptance fails, install the required fire suppression, evacuation, smoke exhaust, and structural protection measures and request re-inspection within thirty days. If the production license is suspended because of equipment nonconformity, remediate the production line and submit a corrective action plan to the provincial medical products administration for re-inspection.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Provincial Medical Products Administration delegated by the National Medical Products Administration (NMPA), together with the Municipal Ecological Environment Bureau and the Civil Defense Fire and Rescue Division
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Medical Device Production License for Class II sterile medical examination gloves and Medical Device Registration Certificate for powder-free sterile synthetic nitrile examination gloves, together with the Civil Defense Fire Safety Acceptance Certificate and Environmental Impact Assessment Approval.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment and the municipal Ecological Environment Bureau where the plant is located
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Full Environmental Impact Report with public participation, because the project involves chemical dipping, rubber or polymer processing, drying and curing, surface treatment, and sterilization, which falls within industrial manufacturing categories requiring an EIA report or report form; an environmental registration is not sufficient for the primary manufacturing line.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater from dipping, leaching, cooling, and cleaning must meet indirect discharge standards for municipal sewers under GB/T 31962-2015 or local discharge permits, with design benchmarks of pH 6-9, chemical oxygen demand not exceeding 500 mg/L, biochemical oxygen demand not exceeding 300 mg/L, suspended solids not exceeding 400 mg/L, ammonia nitrogen not exceeding 45 mg/L, and total zinc not exceeding 5 mg/L where zinc-based coagulants are used. Air emissions from dipping, curing, drying, and chlorination must be controlled by adsorption, absorption, or thermal oxidation systems and comply with the stricter of the approved environmental impact statement, local emission standards, GB 27632-2011 for the rubber products industry, and GB 37824-2019 for volatile organic compounds; the project should be designed to achieve non-methane total hydrocarbons not exceeding 50 mg/m3, benzene not exceeding 1 mg/m3, particulate matter not exceeding 10 mg/m3, and a volatile organic compound removal efficiency of at least 95%. Hazardous waste, including latex residues, waste activated carbon, waste coatings, spent solvents, and contaminated packaging, must be segregated, stored in a permittable hazardous waste warehouse, manifested, and transported to a licensed hazardous waste treatment facility within statutory storage periods.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: The plant must obtain a Civil Defense Fire Safety Design Review Certificate and a Fire Safety Completion Acceptance Certificate from the Fire and Rescue Division for the production building, warehousing areas, sterilization rooms, and chemical storage rooms. Structural load approval must be obtained for dipping tank supports, drying ovens, curing lines, overhead conveyors, and mezzanine storage. Occupancies must comply with workplace safety and health codes, including emergency evacuation routes, fire suppression systems, gas detection, flammable liquid storage, and hazardous chemical safety assessment. Boilers, pressure vessels, sterilizers, and lifts must be registered with the market regulation special equipment safety supervision authority. The WFOE must also complete an occupational hazard risk evaluation and a control effect evaluation under the Law on Prevention and Control of Occupational Diseases before commencing operations.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA), accessed through the China Electronic Taxpayer Service Platform (e-Tax); the Hong Kong SAR element of the structure is under the Inland Revenue Department (IRD) for profits tax purposes only.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Upon incorporation, the WFOE receives an 18-digit Unified Social Credit Code (USCC) from the State Administration for Market Regulation; the USCC is the taxpayer identification number. The WFOE must then complete tax registration through the e-Tax portal with the competent STA tax authority, filing legal representative details, accounting and bookkeeping rules, bank account information, and payroll data. For export of nitrile gloves, the WFOE must complete customs registration with the General Administration of Customs, complete the Ministry of Commerce foreign trade operator filing, register as a VAT general taxpayer, and enrol in the STA export tax refund/exemption system. A foreign non-resident parent should file Non-Resident Enterprise Tax Registration with the STA to obtain a non-resident tax record for PRC withholding tax; if relying on the Mainland/Hong Kong double tax arrangement, the parent should obtain a Certificate of Hong Kong Resident Status from the IRD and submit it to the STA.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None. The PRC has no check-the-box, pass-through, or hybrid mismatch election for a WFOE. The WFOE is mandatorily an entity-level CIT taxpayer at the 25% statutory rate. The VAT general taxpayer status is an administrative VAT classification, not a corporate entity election; a taxpayer below the CNY 5 million threshold may apply to the tax authority for voluntary general taxpayer registration.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT - Value-Added Tax of the People's Republic of China; Hong Kong SAR does not impose VAT, GST, or sales tax.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: CNY 5,000,000 annual taxable sales for mandatory VAT general taxpayer registration; the WFOE must complete VAT/tax registration upon incorporation without any minimum turnover threshold. Hong Kong SAR: not applicable.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The STA mandates issuance of fully digitalized electronic invoices through the STA Electronic Invoice Service Platform. Each invoice carries a unique national invoice number, dynamic QR code, and encrypted digital signature; issuance data is transmitted to the STA in real time. Golden Tax Phase IV automatically cross-checks invoice data, customs declarations, bank settlement records, and export logistics. VAT special invoices are cleared before input credit can be claimed; approved ERP and accounting systems must use the STA e-invoice API interface. Sales returns and credit notes must be processed as red-letter electronic invoices in the platform. For exports, the zero-rating claim is electronically linked to the GACC export declaration and the SAFE-designated bank's foreign exchange receipt record. Hong Kong SAR has no indirect-tax fiscal clearance mandate.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: The WFOE may claim the 0% export VAT rate for nitrile examination gloves only if it is a registered VAT general taxpayer; the gloves are physically exported from mainland China under customs supervision and reported on a GACC export customs declaration; the sale is made to a non-PRC buyer; the WFOE retains a commercial invoice, transport document, and payment instructions from outside China; the export proceeds are repatriated to a SAFE-designated bank account within the statutory deadline; and the STA export tax refund/exemption declaration is filed electronically. Qualifying cross-border offshore services may also be zero-rated if the service is supplied to a non-PRC customer and performed outside mainland China, but goods must satisfy the physical export test.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Declaration Form for Export Goods with the GACC export declaration number
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical shipment from the PRC to the offshore destination
Export Proceeds Collection Certificate from a SAFE-designated bank, being the mainland equivalent of a foreign inward remittance certificate
Commercial invoice and packing list matching the export customs declaration
Export tax refund/exemption declaration filed through the STA electronic export tax refund system
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Under the Tax Collection and Administration Law of the People's Republic of China, the STA and GACC will deny or claw back the export zero-rating benefit if the customs declaration, transport documents, foreign exchange receipts, or invoice records are false, incomplete, or inconsistent. The enterprise will be required to repay the VAT refunded, pay late-payment surcharge of 0.05% per day, and may be subject to an administrative fine ranging from 50% to 500% of the tax shortfall for fraudulent conduct. Criminal tax fraud liability can arise under the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China for a deliberately fraudulent export tax refund. SAFE may also impose monetary penalties for failure to repatriate export proceeds within 180 days, and GACC can sanction false export declarations. Golden Tax Phase IV audit scrutiny remains open for the statutory limitation period and may require full documentary substantiation of the entire trade chain.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: People's Bank of China (PBOC), with the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) as the delegated foreign-exchange administrative enforcement authority
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China operates a current-account convertible but capital-account controlled currency regime. For this medical-PPE manufacturing WFOE, ordinary trade-related import and export receipts can be converted to CNY at onshore designated banks under SAFE's total-quantity trade monitoring framework, without case-by-case approval. However, capital account flows such as FDI equity injection, shareholder loans, cross-border debt, and profit repatriation require strict SAFE registration, true-to-use verification, and documentary compliance. The RMB is not freely convertible offshore; every cross-border movement must be linked to an underlying goods, service, or registered capital transaction. There is no statutory mandatory conversion ratio: since the SAFE reforms, export proceeds may be retained 100% in foreign currency or sold to banks at the onshore market rate. Nevertheless, goods-export proceeds must be repatriated to a licensed onshore goods-trade foreign exchange account, generally within 180 days from customs export declaration unless an approved extension is granted. Profit remittance to the Hong Kong parent is permitted only after annual audit, corporate income tax settlement, tax clearance, and bank verification of a board-approved profit distribution resolution, with SAFE-monitored outward remittance purpose codes.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender percentage currently applies; the effective conversion ratio is 0% surrendered, meaning 100% of export foreign currency receipts may be retained in an onshore goods-trade foreign exchange settlement account or voluntarily converted into CNY at the prevailing spot rate. Statutory repatriation for ordinary exports is required within 180 days from the date of customs export declaration (goods shipment), with advance receipts requiring the enterprise to register under SAFE's trade monitoring system and declare the expected export date within 30 days. The designated receiving bank verifies customs declarations, commercial invoices, logistics documentation, and received remittances through the SAFE cross-border payment monitoring platform before allowing credit or conversion.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Capital Settlement Foreign Currency Account + Goods-Trade Foreign Exchange Settlement Account + CNY Basic Deposit Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China Limited
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: FDI Capital Settlement Foreign Currency Account + Goods-Trade Foreign Exchange Settlement Account + CNY Basic Deposit Account
FDI Capital Settlement Foreign Currency Account + Goods-Trade Foreign Exchange Settlement Account + CNY Basic Deposit Account
FDI Capital Settlement Foreign Currency Account + Goods-Trade Foreign Exchange Settlement Account + CNY Basic Deposit Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Offshore digital EMI and fintech neo-banking platforms are not viable as primary operating accounts for a China-domiciled WFOE. They are not licensed deposit-taking institutions in mainland China, cannot hold the WFOE's capital account, and are legally barred from performing the onshore trade verification and SAFE reporting required for CNY clearing, export proceeds repatriation, or FDI capital settlement. They can at best function as auxiliary overseas receivables collection rails through a licensed onshore bank partner, but they cannot replace a Tier-1 domestic commercial bank account for regulatory, treasury, or tax purposes. The correct architecture is an onshore bank as the anchor account with the EMI prohibited from servicing any capital-account or statutory-trade flow.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For a first-time corporate account opening by a WFOE, the statutory legal representative and at least one authorized signatory must generally appear physically at a designated Chinese bank branch. If the legal representative is a foreign national resident in Hong Kong or elsewhere, the bank may accept a notarized and Chinese-consulate-legalized power of attorney appointing a local senior manager, but the KYC compliance committee will still require a live video or recorded remote interview with the legal representative, ultimate beneficial owners, and all signatories. Pure remote consular proxy opening is not routinely permitted; the company chop/seal must be physically created and retained in mainland China, and the bank's control room will verify board resolutions appointing the legal representative and finance officer before granting signing limits.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ownership opacity and potential shell-holding structure due to the Hong Kong parent company and the WFOE's zero minimum capital requirement
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide Hong Kong Companies Registry incorporation certificate, NAR1 annual return, NC1 form, full shareholding chain from ultimate natural persons to the WFOE, notarized passport copies of each ultimate beneficial owner, independent legal opinion from a PRC law firm confirming beneficial ownership, audited financial statements of the Hong Kong parent, board resolution authorizing incorporation of the WFOE, and a written UBO declaration with source-of-funds evidence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions, adverse-media, and PEP screening matches triggered by Chinese-named shareholders or cross-border signatory conglomerates
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver commercially screened sanctions/PEP reports for all directors and shareholders, notarized identity documents, description of the actual manufacturing factory in China with utility bills and lease agreements, PEP status declaration or evidence of legitimate public-office role if applicable, source-of-wealth and source-of-funds letters, and a certified copy of the WFOE's business licence and industry health-regulatory permits.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Trade-based money laundering red flag where export receipts for nitrile gloves exceed expected unit prices or shipment volumes versus declared customs value
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Prepare a detailed trade file for each major shipment: purchase order, commercial invoice, packing list, bill of lading/air waybill, Chinese customs export declaration, sterilization or quality certificates for medical examination gloves, independent pricing benchmark against global nitrile glove index or third-party pricing service, proof of factory capacity and power consumption, and supplier/procurement contracts showing cost matching.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ambiguity in financial signing authority and use of the WFOE company chop, particularly when multiple authorized signatories or Hong Kong directors hold mixed mandates
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Furnish the WFOE's constitutional documents, articles of association, board minutes resolving the appointment of legal representative and senior financial officer, bank signatory cards with signature specimens, internal chop-use policy, a written delegation-of-authority matrix, and a PRC legal opinion confirming that the formation of statutory contractual obligations complies with China's Company Law and the foreign investment filing regime.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity funding from the Hong Kong shareholder shall be routed as FDI through the WFOE's SAFE-registered capital settlement account at the designated Tier-1 onshore bank. The remitting bank in Hong Kong must issue an SWIFT MT103 with remittance purpose clearly stated as 'Direct Investment - Equity Injection for WFOE Paid-In Capital Increase', including the name of the Chinese investee company and the registered FDI filing confirmation code. Before settlement into CNY, the receiving bank will perform a true-to-use review against the WFOE's business permit, foreign investment information report, SAFE FDI registration, and board resolution. The converted CNY must be used only for approved operating expenditures within the business scope of sterile nitrile glove manufacturing; capital-fund diversion into equity, securities, entrusted loans, or real estate is strictly prohibited. Where bank policy or the industry requires, the WFOE shall obtain a capital verification report from a licensed accounting firm evidencing paid-in capital receipts from the true overseas investor.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound payments for raw materials, packaging, sterilization consumables, and equipment shall use the goods-trade foreign exchange payment rails under SAFE monitoring. For open-account or prepayment purchases, the WFOE must instruct SWIFT MT103 payments through the onshore bank, attaching import purchase contracts, proforma invoices, customs declarations, transport bills, and tax-compliant invoices before conversion or debiting. For large-stage procurement of nitrile latex and packaging materials, an irrevocable documentary letter of credit (SWIFT MT700) issued through the Tier-1 bank is recommended, with accepted drafts paid under MT103 against compliant documents. Documentary collections (D/P and D/A) may be used for working capital efficiency, but all documents must be consistent with customs values and the trade monitoring system; any related-party cross-border payment must also carry transfer pricing documentation to avoid customs and tax recharacterization.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore deliverable USD/CNY FX forward contracts with real current-account or capital-account trade background
Onshore USD/CNY FX swaps for intra-quarter liquidity and cash-flow gap management
Long-dated cross-currency swaps for hedging an existing foreign-currency shareholder loan or syndicated facility
Plain vanilla CNY/USD options and option combination strategies approved under SAFE hedging eligibility
Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are not permissible for onshore WFOE settlement and must be excluded from the treasury hedging policy

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) via local Market Supervision Administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 - June 30 of each year for the preceding calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing triggers inclusion in the List of Enterprises with Abnormal Operations; failure to remedy within 3 years leads to inclusion in the Serious Illegal and Dishonest List and potential administrative revocation of the business license (strike-off). Administrative fines up to RMB 10,000 for severe cases may also apply.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign-Invested Enterprise Annual Investment Information Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) and SAMR via the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-submission or false submission may result in written rectification orders, negative credit records, and possible restrictions on government support and statutory licenses; persistent non-compliance can trigger administrative penalties (fine up to RMB 30,000).

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Income Tax Annual Reconciliation (Annual Settlement)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA) - local competent tax authority
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before May 31 of the year following the accounting year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing attracts a late-payment surcharge of 0.05% per day on unpaid tax; the tax authority may impose a fine from RMB 2,000 to RMB 20,000 (or 20% of unpaid tax for seriously violative false filings). Serious cases may trigger administrative penalties, seizure of bank accounts, and criminal referral for tax evasion.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) - local branch
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: June 30 of each year (via bank or SAFE online system)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to complete the annual foreign exchange reporting may lead to restrictions on foreign exchange transactions, denial of dividend remittances, and inclusion in the foreign exchange credit record; repeat offenders face fines up to RMB 50,000 under the Foreign Exchange Administrative Penalty Provisions.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Customs Annual Report (Import/Export and Customs Registration)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit the annual customs declaration can result in suspension of customs clearance, downgrade of enterprise credit rating, and fines up to RMB 10,000; continuous non-compliance triggers stricter verification and potential revocation of customs registration.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) - local statistics bureau
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Before March 31 of the following year (or as locally notified; some districts designate April or May)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-submission leads to a deadline reminder and penalty up to RMB 20,000 for enterprises according to the Statistics Law; severe cases include publication of violations and downward statistical credibility.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Self-Inspection Report for Medical Device Production License (drafted as required by the sterile glove manufacturing scope)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: National Medical Products Administration (NMPA) / provincial drug administration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 30 of each year (annual quality system self-inspection and submission)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to submit may lead to suspension of production license, administrative penalties, and prohibition from producing medical devices until re-inspection is cleared; continued violation may cause revocation of the license.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Under Article 164 of the PRC Company Law, every company (including a wholly foreign-owned enterprise) must have its annual financial reports audited by an accounting firm. There is no quantitative exemption based on turnover, total assets, or headcount. Therefore, the statutory threshold is zero: 100% of Chinese WFOEs must undergo a mandatory independent Certified Public Accountant statutory audit each fiscal year. The audit must cover the balance sheet, income statement, cash flow statement, and notes prepared under China Accounting Standards.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Accounting Standards for Business Enterprises (China GAAP / CAS), substantially converged with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS). Full CAS applies; no simplified SME standards are available to foreign-invested enterprises.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under China's Beneficial Ownership Information Management Measures, every enterprise must file beneficial ownership information with the SAMR at incorporation and within 30 days of any change. Annual confirmation is not separately required; however, the annual enterprise report includes a standard representation that beneficial ownership information is accurate as of the reporting date. Therefore, the protocol is: annual declaration via the enterprise annual reporting system plus a 30-day change reporting window for any shareholding or beneficial ownership transfers.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Directors, Supervisors and Senior Management
Minute Book of Shareholders' and Board Resolutions

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Qualified High and New Technology Enterprises may apply a 15% reduced rate; small low-profit enterprises derive an effective 5% taxable income rate via the 20% reduced rate for taxable income under the applicable statutory thresholds; an additional 100% R&D expense deduction is available for qualifying manufacturing/medical device R&D; certain encouraged free-trade-zone or regional projects may access 15% rates or temporary holidays, but no automatic patent box applies to nitrile glove manufacturing.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: PRC Enterprise Income Tax Annual Return (Form A) filed with the State Taxation Administration through the official electronic tax bureau e-filing portal (e-Tax); related schedules including the depreciation table, tax preference table, foreign tax credit table and controlled-transaction table must be attached.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Annual return due on or before May 31 of the calendar year following the fiscal year-end; quarterly provisional CIT payments due within 15 days after each quarter-end; withholding enterprise income tax on dividend, interest and royalty remittances to non-residents due within 7 days after each payment date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Entity identification: taxpayer name, unified social credit code, legal representative, registered address, industry code, and fiscal period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the WFOE's Chinese unified social credit code and exact registered address in the manufacturing zone; identify the ultimate Hong Kong parent in the related-party schedule; state the industry code corresponding to ISIC 3250/NAICS 339113 and the medical device production license number.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Accounting period: start and end date of the reported fiscal period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a newly formed WFOE, report from incorporation/in-business date to December 31; if the board has adopted a different fiscal year under approval, attach the tax authority acceptance; no prorated CIT rate change unless Chinese law changes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total operating revenue: revenue from main business and other operating revenue.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Include all export sales of powder-free synthetic nitrile gloves, including sales to the HK distribution affiliate, at the contract price; if the invoice value differs from the customs declaration or arm's-length price, attach a transfer pricing reconciliation; all offshore e-commerce revenue is taxable Chinese income because the WFOE is the Chinese manufacturer and seller.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total operating cost: cost of goods sold, selling expenses, administrative expenses, finance costs and R&D expenditure.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deduct only properly documented purchases of nitrile latex compound, gloves-dipping production line depreciation, packaging, labor and utility costs; disallow artificial management fees or royalty payments to a HK shell unless supported by commercial substance and arm's-length terms; cross-match purchase invoices with customs records.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Total profit before tax: net profit computed under PRC Accounting Standards.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Reconcile to audited financial statements; if the HK parent has transferred risks to the WFOE without capital, adjust profit to retain arm's-length return for manufacturing and assume risk; no deduction for dividend distributions to HK shareholders.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income after tax adjustments: additions and deductions reported in the general ledger adjustment schedules.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Add back non-deductible related-party management fees above the 5% administrative expense limit, super-related interest in excess of the thin capitalization debt-equity ratio, and non-arm's-length royalties; deduct depreciation per tax law, R&D super deduction, and domestic preference items; reference the transfer pricing adjustments adopted in the audit.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Applicable CIT rate and computed enterprise income tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply 25% base rate unless the WFOE holds a valid High and New Technology Enterprise certificate (15%) or qualifies for a regional incentive; the rate on this box is the entity-level CIT, not the dividend withholding tax.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Foreign tax credit for foreign-source taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Creditable only for China tax paid abroad on the WFOE's own foreign branches or permanent establishments; no credit for income taxes paid by the HK parent or by unrelated foreign customers; obsolete if all glove sales are booked in China.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-resident payment declaration: dividends, interest and royalties paid to foreign/HK related parties.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Every payment to the HK shareholder or affiliate must be declared in the withholding schedule; if claiming Mainland-HK DTA relief, attach the HK Tax Residency Certificate, beneficial ownership statement and 25% shareholding proof before remittance; if treaty relief is not yet approved, withhold and pay 10% or the applicable statutory rate by the filing deadline.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Controlled transaction disclosure: intercompany transactions with related parties.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all sales of gloves to the HK entity, purchases from HK or third-country related suppliers, intercompany loans, management fees and royalty payments; if annual related-party tangible asset transfers exceed RMB 200 million, intangible or financial asset transfers exceed RMB 100 million, or other controlled transactions exceed RMB 40 million, contemporaneous Local File documentation must be filed/produced; include a copy of the group Master File if the consolidated revenue threshold is met.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax preferences and exemptions claimed in the current year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only claim incentives substantiated by certificates or contracts: 15% HNTE, R&D 100% super deduction, qualified use of specialized equipment, preferential free-trade-zone or western-region measures; unsupported offshore claims and shell-company preferences are red flags.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Payment summary: quarterly prepayments made, final tax payable, refund or carryforward.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Offset the quarterly CIT prepayments; final balance must be paid by May 31; if withholding tax on a dividend to the HK shareholder remains unpaid, the WFOE as withholding agent is liable for the unpaid tax, surcharge and penalty, and the tax authority may pursue the directors personally for causing the company to fail in its statutory withholding obligations.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: Tax Administration Law Article 62 imposes a RMB 2,000-10,000 fine (or RMB 10,000-50,000 if serious); late payment interest is 0.05% per day, compounded to roughly 18.25% per annum. False or fraudulent filing: Article 63 imposes recovery of the underpaid tax, interest and a penalty of 50% (0.5x) to five times the underpaid tax; falsely issuing or using VAT invoices attracts Criminal Law Article 205 penalties, including life imprisonment for large sums. Criminal tax evasion under Criminal Law Article 201 applies when the evaded tax exceeds RMB 50,000 and is more than 10% of the tax payable, with imprisonment up to seven years; entities and responsible directors are both subject to fines, confiscation, travel restrictions and inclusion in the State Administration for Market Regulation/Joint Punishment list, which may suspend export clearance of the medical PPE production business.
